description: Backend: restored-room pool always reflects the live catalog (Fc26Catalog.refresh used by restore preview/create, pool route and START of restored rooms) and restored rooms never have a retention phase (server forced OFF, retention commands rejected, ongoingStatus waits for unclaimed teams). Independent of FEAT-002 except for the shared test file; do it first.
steps: fc26.catalog.ts: add refresh(maxAgeMs=10000) to Fc26Catalog and IndexedFc26Catalog (track load time in ensure(), drop cache when older). Update any other Fc26Catalog implementers/mocks (grep).
restore.routes.ts: await fc26.refresh() in catalogs() and in GET /api/rooms/:code/restore/pool. auction.engine.ts START_AUCTION: if room.restore, await fc26.refresh(0) before fc26.list().

retention.service.ts: retentionPhase returns 'OFF' for restored rooms; requireEnabledLobby throws RETENTION_NOT_ENABLED for restored rooms. room-state.ts retentionState reports enabled false for restored rooms. room-summary.ts ongoingStatus: restored rooms with unclaimed teams are WAITING_FOR_TEAMS, never READY_TO_START.

backend/tests/restore.test.ts: add describe('v2 pool and retention'): a player added after the first list() appears in preview, pool route and the started auction; Openda and Neymar Jr are in the remaining pool and excluded when owned; START_RETENTION/FINALIZE_RETENTIONS rejected; state retention.enabled false; START works once all teams are claimed with no retention step; non-restored retention flow unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Preview, lobby pool and the started auction include catalog players added after the server first loaded the catalog, and exclude players owned by restored teams
L. Openda and Neymar Jr are in the remaining pool of the template restore
Restored rooms reject every retention command and expose no retention phase; START succeeds once all teams are claimed
Non-restored rooms and existing retention tests behave as before
verification: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/restore.test.ts
cd backend; npx vitest run (baseline: 6 skip-vote failures and load-only timeouts are known)
findings: Catalog: Fc26Catalog.refresh(maxAgeMs=10000) added (IndexedFc26Catalog tracks loadedAt; only MemoryFc26Catalog/PostgresFc26Catalog implement it). Restore catalogs(), pool route call refresh(); START_AUCTION calls refresh(0) for restored rooms. Retention: retentionPhase returns OFF when room.restore; requireEnabledLobby and resetRetentions throw RETENTION_NOT_ENABLED for restored rooms; retentionState.enabled false; ongoingStatus WAITING_FOR_TEAMS while restored teams unclaimed. Tests: restore.test.ts setup(repository?, fc26?) now takes optional catalog (3rd-party test helper LiveCatalog subclass overrides load()); new describe 'v2 pool and retention' (3 tests). tsc OK; restore.test.ts 32/32 pass; full vitest 382 pass, 7 fail = known baseline (5 skip-vote + 1 integration skip-vote + manager-mode load timeout). Frontend still uses retention.enabled; server now reports false for restored rooms, FEAT-003 still should gate by !restore.
